sourceFile: 2. BRS-161016 (DT) Report  test new machine dry date 2024.03.09_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it merges distinct process sheets and misstates the changed factor and outcome groupings.
issues: Changed factor is malformed and includes dates/times as conditions.
BP.SM, Sub 3, and Yoke processes are merged without clear subgroup control.
Several outcomes use header or unrelated rows as measurements.
Normal vs Test baselines are inconsistently paired across dates and products.
Judgements include unsupported worsening from uncited context rows.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as new dry machine/process dry condition versus normal dry.
Split or subgroup by sheet/process and preserve date, temp, time, pad/type, and line.
Rebuild outcomes from actual result rows, not headers or detected-table artifacts.
Pair Test and Normal only within comparable process/date/condition context.
Retain concise evidence rows for title, purpose, conditions, results, and decisions.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row ids exist, but citations are too broad and grouping evidence is insufficient.
